sources.snippet: Note: Having a separate repo for ONNX weights is intended to be a temporary solution until WebML gains more traction. If you would like to make your models web-ready, we recommend converting to ONNX using 🤗 Optimum and structuring your repo like this one (with ONNX weights located in a subfolder named onnx).

sources.snippet: hubert-large-ls960-ft is a large automatic speech recognition model developed by Meta and released under the Apache 2.0 license. It is a fine-tuned version of hubert-large-ll60k, trained on 960 hours of Librispeech data for English audio sampled at 16kHz.

sources.snippet: Overview hubert-large-ls960-ft is a large self-supervised speech recognition model built by facebook that performs automatic speech recognition on 16kHz sampled audio. The model is a fine-tuned version of hubert-large-ll60k, trained on 960 hours of Librispeech data.
